import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date to datetime
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Total Sales by Product
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = sns.color_palette('YlOrBr', len(product_sales))
bars = ax1.barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
# Add value labels
for bar, val in zip(bars, product_sales.values):
    ax1.text(val + 50, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'${val:,.0f}', 
             va='center', fontsize=9)

# Plot 2: Sales Distribution by Customer Age Group and Payment Method
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_payment = df.groupby(['customer_age_group', 'payment_method'])['total'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
# Define order for age groups
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_payment = age_payment.reindex([x for x in age_order if x in age_payment.index])
age_payment.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax2, color=sns.color_palette('Set2', len(age_payment.columns)), width=0.8)
ax2.set_xlabel('Customer Age Group', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Sales by Age Group & Payment Method', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(title='Payment Method', loc='upper right', fontsize=9)
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# Plot 3: Sales by Size (Pie Chart)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
size_sales = df.groupby('size')['total'].sum()
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_sales = size_sales.reindex([x for x in size_order if x in size_sales.index])
colors_pie = ['#8B4513', '#D2691E', '#F4A460']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(size_sales.values, labels=size_sales.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_pie,
                                    explode=[0.02]*len(size_sales), shadow=True)
ax3.set_title('Sales Distribution by Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_fontsize(10)
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# Plot 4: Daily Sales Trend
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
daily_sales = df.groupby('date')['total'].sum().reset_index()
ax4.plot(daily_sales['date'], daily_sales['total'], color='#8B4513', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.7)
ax4.fill_between(daily_sales['date'], daily_sales['total'], alpha=0.3, color='#D2691E')
# Add rolling average
rolling_avg = daily_sales['total'].rolling(window=7, min_periods=1).mean()
ax4.plot(daily_sales['date'], rolling_avg, color='darkred', linewidth=2, 
         linestyle='--', label='7-day Moving Average')
ax4.set_xlabel('Date', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Daily Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Daily Sales Trend Over Time', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=9)
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Add summary statistics as text
total_revenue = df['total'].sum()
avg_transaction = df['total'].mean()
total_transactions = len(df)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Add a text box with key metrics
fig.text(0.5, -0.02, f'Key Metrics: Total Revenue: ${total_revenue:,.2f} | Total Transactions: {total_transactions:,} | Avg Transaction: ${avg_transaction:.2f}', 
         ha='center', fontsize=11, style='italic', 
         bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.5))

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
